description: Search Senate LDA lobbying filings from the complete corpus — every quarterly report (LD-2) in the covered window, not a sample. Returns registrant, client, spending amount, issue codes and the committees each filing touches, plus exact totals. Filter by quarter, by organization, or both. Amounts are plausibility-gated (income <= $5M, expenses <= $50M per filing).

limit.description: Rows to return, largest amount first. Default 50. Totals always cover every match.

organization.description: Client or registrant name. Matched on a normalized form, so "Pfizer Inc." and "PFIZER, INC." reach the same filings.

year.description: Filing year. Omit to search every quarter the corpus covers.

name: search_lobbying
title: Lobbying filings search
